[1/3] Plan: document the implicit state machines, add a canonical registry and inspector, unify the action gate, and expose it to REST/CLI

impact_assessment.why: The game encodes 20+ machines in fields and branches with no canonical contract; decision/pirate/customs gates are duplicated across engine, server and CLI; flight actions bypass combat and anomaly (proved: orbit/travel succeed during both), and void_dive bypasses decision/pirate/customs. Agents must reconstruct all of this from scattered fields.
impact_assessment.benefits: One registry documents every machine, state, transition and surface gate; /api/state-machines and `voidfarer state-machines` expose the current state and blockers; one engine action gate consistently blocks combat/anomaly/void/decision/pirate/customs; research switches report discarded progress.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: engine action gating, server GET surface, CLI command, state snapshot; dependency: none; concurrency: inspector reads under the engine lock; state: no save-schema change; regression: existing decision/pirate/customs gates, tests and 60fps cockpit stay intact; stricter combat/anomaly gating may reject previously allowed actions.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Failing-first tests for the gate holes and registry invariants, full suite and project gate, browser smoke test of the cockpit, and a documented deferral for tick-precedence changes.

checkpoints.description: State-machine contract verified: 24-machine registry/inspector, REST+CLI surfaces, combat/anomaly/void flight gates, research message; 21 new tests, 1333 suite, gate 5/5; checklists: passed
